title: Physical split-phase dynamic polymer and application thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a physical phase-splitting dynamic polymer, which comprises dynamic polymer molecules with hard segments and soft segments. The dynamic polymer molecules are mixed with each other and/or can form crystalline phases and/or phases incompatible with the soft segments independently of each other to form phase-separated physical cross-links or cross-links and polymerizations based on the hard segments; each soft segment of the dynamic polymer molecule is in an amorphous state; the dynamic polymer molecule contains at least one boron-containing dynamic covalent bond and optional hydrogen bond groups in the molecule to provide dynamic reversibility, so that the physical split-phase dynamic polymer has good toughness, energy dissipation, self-repairing property and other performances, and has wide application in the aspects of physical protection, army physical protection, explosion protection, air drop and air drop protection, automobile anti-collision, electronic material impact protection, self-repairing sealing elements, sealing glue, tough elastomer and the like of sports and daily life and work.
